heading: Art. 140. Delegation by the President
lead: The President may delegate any authority vested in him under this chapter, and provide for the subdelegation of any such authority.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes Revised sectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 94050:736.May 5, 1950, ch. 169, § 1 (Art. 140), 64 Stat. 145. The word “may” is substituted for the words “is authorized to * * * to”.
